content.title: Configurable branch name for agt init
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md

Add --branch <name> flag to agt init so users can specify which orphan branch stores agentrack data. Default remains _agentrack. Enables multiple agentrack instances per repo and test isolation.
